Task (3D, static): write an HTML page that builds the scene from code and renders it so that the view from your reference camera reproduces the image as faithfully as you can: characters, poses, facial expressions, hands, props, background, and colors. A later step will animate your scene, so structure it in named groups. For this static step, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one

<!DOCTYPE html>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const width = 240;
const height = 294;
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();

const noiseGLSL = `
  float grain(vec2 p) {
    vec3 h = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031);
    h += dot(h, h.yzx + 33.33);
    return fract((h.x + h.y) * h.z);
  }
`;

const studio = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2), new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  depthTest: false,
  depthWrite: false,
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec2 vUv;
    void main() {
      vUv = uv;
      gl_Position = vec4(position.xy, 0.999, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    varying vec2 vUv;
    ${noiseGLSL}
    void main() {
      float y = 1.0 - vUv.y;
      vec3 color = mix(vec3(0.790, 0.776, 0.749), vec3(0.938, 0.939, 0.919),
                       smoothstep(0.0, 0.30, y));
      color = mix(color, vec3(0.998, 0.998, 0.988), smoothstep(0.15, 0.50, y));
      color = mix(color, vec3(0.962, 0.963, 0.942), smoothstep(0.71, 0.80, y));
      color = mix(color, vec3(0.652, 0.659, 0.615), smoothstep(0.77, 1.035, y));
      float side = (vUv.x - 0.5) * (0.018 * (1.0 - y));
      vec2 pixel = floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
      float value = (grain(pixel) - 0.5) * (0.032 + 0.033 * abs(2.0 * y - 1.0));
      float chroma = (grain(pixel + vec2(38.1, 7.5)) - 0.5) * 0.04;
      color += vec3(side + value) + chroma * vec3(0.7, 0.28, -1.0);
      gl_FragColor = vec4(clamp(color, 0.0, 1.0), 1.0);
    }
  `
}));
studio.name = 'gray-studio-background';
studio.frustumCulled = false;
studio.renderOrder = -100;
scene.add(studio);

const surfaceVertex = `
  attribute vec3 restPosition;
  varying vec3 vRest;
  varying vec3 vNormal;
  varying vec2 vUv;
  void main() {
    vRest = restPosition;
    vUv = uv;
    vNormal = normalize(mat3(modelMatrix) * normal);
    gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
  }
`;

function skinMaterial(mode) {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: { mode: { value: mode } },
    transparent: mode === 3,
    depthWrite: mode !== 3,
    vertexShader: surfaceVertex,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform int mode;
      varying vec3 vRest;
      varying vec3 vNormal;
      varying vec2 vUv;
      ${noiseGLSL}

      vec3 skin(float y) {
        vec3 c = mix(vec3(0.900, 0.839, 0.389), vec3(0.866, 0.714, 0.284),
                     smoothstep(25.0, 63.0, y));
        c = mix(c, vec3(0.963, 0.823, 0.329), smoothstep(61.0, 99.0, y));
        c = mix(c, vec3(0.908, 0.727, 0.275), smoothstep(105.0, 174.0, y));
        return mix(c, vec3(0.817, 0.595, 0.226), smoothstep(170.0, 235.0, y));
      }

      void main() {
        float x = vRest.x + 120.0;
        float y = 147.0 - vRest.y;
        vec3 n = normalize(vNormal);
        vec3 color = skin(y);

        if (mode == 0 || mode == 3) {
          vec2 oval = vec2((x - 101.0) / 64.0, (y - 154.0) / 64.0);
          float front = smoothstep(-3.0, 28.0, vRest.z);
          float bellyMask = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.80, 1.025, length(oval))) * front;
          vec3 belly = mix(vec3(0.984, 0.915, 0.697), vec3(0.961, 0.873, 0.681),
                           smoothstep(104.0, 132.0, y));
          belly = mix(belly, vec3(0.833, 0.759, 0.598), smoothstep(127.0, 162.0, y));
          belly = mix(belly, vec3(0.877, 0.675, 0.323), smoothstep(158.0, 192.0, y));
          belly = mix(belly, skin(y), smoothstep(190.0, 220.0, y));
          color = mix(color, belly, bellyMask);
          vec2 muzzle = vec2((x - 102.0) / 18.0, (y - 52.0) / 11.0);
          color -= exp(-dot(muzzle, muzzle)) * smoothstep(3.0, 23.0, vRest.z)
                   * vec3(0.025, 0.050, 0.025);
        } else if (mode == 1) {
          color = mix(color, vec3(0.510, 0.404, 0.183), smoothstep(143.0, 181.0, y));
          color = mix(color, vec3(0.283, 0.252, 0.177), smoothstep(173.0, 196.0, y));
          color = mix(color, vec3(0.245, 0.219, 0.164), smoothstep(196.0, 222.0, y));
        } else {
          color = mix(vec3(0.829, 0.610, 0.245), vec3(0.665, 0.470, 0.204),
                      smoothstep(211.0, 300.0, y));
          float inside = x < 100.0 ? n.x : -n.x;
          color *= 1.0 - 0.15 * smoothstep(0.0, 0.93, inside);
        }

        vec3 key = normalize(vec3(-0.36, 0.63, 0.69));
        vec3 bounce = normalize(vec3(0.67, 0.37, -0.64));
        float light = 0.843 + 0.158 * max(dot(key, n), 0.0)
                    + 0.093 * max(dot(bounce, n), 0.0) - 0.045 * max(-n.y, 0.0);
        color *= light;
        vec2 pixel = floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
        float fine = grain(pixel);
        vec2 fleck = floor(vec2(vRest.x + vRest.z * 0.44, vRest.y - vRest.z * 0.27) * 1.32);
        float nap = grain(fleck);
        color += (fine - 0.5) * vec3(0.048, 0.051, 0.061);
        color += (nap - 0.5) * vec3(0.037, 0.033, 0.024);
        color += (grain(pixel + vec2(74.6, 5.2)) - 0.5) * vec3(0.027, 0.014, -0.039);
        float alpha = 1.0;
        if (mode == 3) {
          alpha = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.76, 1.0, length(vUv * 2.0 - 1.0));
        }
        gl_FragColor = vec4(clamp(color, 0.0, 1.0), alpha);
      }
    `
  });
}

function point(x, y, z) {
  return new THREE.Vector3(x - 120, 147 - y, z);
}

function group(name, parent, x, y, z) {
  const node = new THREE.Group();
  node.name = name;
  node.userData.restPivot = point(x, y, z);
  node.position.copy(node.userData.restPivot);
  if (parent.userData.restPivot) node.position.sub(parent.userData.restPivot);
  parent.add(node);
  return node;
}

function profile(rows, y) {
  let i = 0;
  while (i < rows.length - 2 && y > rows[i + 1][0]) i++;
  const a = rows[i];
  const b = rows[i + 1];
  const before = rows[Math.max(0, i - 1)];
  const after = rows[Math.min(rows.length - 1, i + 2)];
  const span = b[0] - a[0];
  const t = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((y - a[0]) / span, 0, 1);
  const t2 = t * t;
  const t3 = t2 * t;
  return a.slice(1).map((value, index) => {
    const j = index + 1;
    const slopeA = (b[j] - before[j]) / (b[0] - before[0]);
    const slopeB = (after[j] - a[j]) / (after[0] - a[0]);
    return (2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) * value + (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) * span * slopeA
         + (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) * b[j] + (t3 - t2) * span * slopeB;
  });
}

function addMesh(name, parent, material, positions, uvs, indices, normals) {
  const pivot = parent.userData.restPivot;
  const local = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < positions.length; i += 3) {
    local.push(positions[i] - pivot.x, positions[i + 1] - pivot.y, positions[i + 2] - pivot.z);
  }
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(local, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('restPosition', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setAttribute('uv', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs, 2));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  if (normals) geometry.setAttribute('normal', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals, 3));
  else geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  mesh.name = name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function loft(name, parent, material, rows, sides = 48, start = rows[0][0], end = rows.at(-1)[0]) {
  const positions = [];
  const normals = [];
  const uvs = [];
  const indices = [];
  const rings = Math.ceil((end - start) / 1.55);

  for (let j = 0; j <= rings; j++) {
    const y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(start, end, j / rings);
    const [x, rx, rz, z] = profile(rows, y);
    const early = Math.max(rows[0][0], y - 0.05);
    const late = Math.min(rows.at(-1)[0], y + 0.05);
    const low = profile(rows, early);
    const high = profile(rows, late);
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const angle = i * Math.PI * 2 / sides;
      const c = Math.cos(angle);
      const s = Math.sin(angle);
      const around = new THREE.Vector3(-rx * s, 0, rz * c);
      const down = new THREE.Vector3(
        high[0] - low[0] + (high[1] - low[1]) * c,
        early - late,
        high[3] - low[3] + (high[2] - low[2]) * s
      );
      positions.push(x + rx * c - 120, 147 - y, z + rz * s);
      normals.push(...around.cross(down).normalize().toArray());
      uvs.push(i / sides, j / rings);

      if (j < rings) {
        const a = j * sides + i;
        const b = j * sides + (i + 1) % sides;
        indices.push(a, b, a + sides, b, b + sides, a + sides);
      }
    }
  }

  for (const top of [true, false]) {
    const y = top ? start : end;
    const [x, , , z] = profile(rows, y);
    const middle = positions.length / 3;
    positions.push(x - 120, 147 - y, z);
    normals.push(0, top ? 1 : -1, 0);
    uvs.push(0.5, 0.5);
    const ring = top ? 0 : rings * sides;
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const a = ring + i;
      const b = ring + (i + 1) % sides;
      if (top) indices.push(middle, b, a);
      else indices.push(middle, a, b);
    }
  }
  return addMesh(name, parent, material, positions, uvs, indices, normals);
}

function addHand(side, arm, palm, fingers, wrist) {
  const hand = group(`hand-${side}`, arm, ...wrist);

function headFront(x, y) {
  const [center, halfWidth, halfDepth, depth] = profile(body, y);
  const xRatio = (x - center) / halfWidth;
  return depth + halfDepth * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.001, 1 - xRatio * xRatio));
}

function swelling(x, y, cx, cy, rx, ry, height) {
  const radiusSquared = ((x - cx) / rx) ** 2 + ((y - cy) / ry) ** 2;
  return height * Math.max(0, 1 - radiusSquared) ** 2;
}

function facePatch(parent, name, cx, cy, rx, ry, rise) {
  const positions = [];
  const uvs = [];
  const indices = [];
  const steps = 9;
  const sides = 40;
  for (let j = 0; j <= steps; j++) {
    const r = j === 0 ? 0.001 : j / steps;
    for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
      const angle = i * 2 * Math.PI / sides;
      const u = r * Math.cos(angle);
      const v = r * Math.sin(angle);
      const x = cx + u * rx;
      const y = cy + v * ry;
      positions.push(...point(x, y, headFront(x, y) + 0.09 + rise(x, y)).toArray());
      uvs.push(0.5 + 0.5 * u, 0.5 + 0.5 * v);
      if (j < steps) {
        const a = j * sides + i;
        const b = j * sides + (i + 1) % sides;
        indices.push(a, b, a + sides, b, b + sides, a + sides);
      }
    }
  }
  const mesh = addMesh(name, parent, eyelidSkin, positions, uvs, indices);
  mesh.renderOrder = 1;
}

function creaseMaterial(rgb, opacity) {
  return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: { ink: { value: new THREE.Vector3(...rgb) }, strength: { value: opacity } },
    transparent: true,
    depthWrite: false,
    side: THREE.DoubleSide,
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main() {
        vUv = uv;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform vec3 ink;
      uniform float strength;
      varying vec2 vUv;
      void main() {
        float ends = smoothstep(0.0, 0.16, vUv.x) * smoothstep(0.0, 0.16, 1.0 - vUv.x);
        float edge = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.07, 1.0, abs(vUv.y * 2.0 - 1.0));
        gl_FragColor = vec4(ink, strength * ends * edge);
      }
    `
  });
}

function crease(name, parent, controls, halfWidth, material, lift = () => 0) {
  const path = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(controls.map(([x, y]) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, 0)));
  const positions = [];
  const uvs = [];
  const indices = [];
  const steps = 36;
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
    const t = i / steps;
    const p = path.getPoint(t);
    const d = path.getTangent(t);
    const w = halfWidth * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(t * Math.PI));
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const x = p.x - d.y * w * side;
      const y = p.y + d.x * w * side;
      positions.push(...point(x, y, headFront(x, y) + 0.28 + lift(x, y)).toArray());
      uvs.push(t, (side + 1) / 2);
    }
    if (i < steps) {
      const a = i * 2;
      indices.push(a, a + 1, a + 2, a + 1, a + 3, a + 2);
    }
  }
  const mesh = addMesh(name, parent, material, positions, uvs, indices);
  mesh.renderOrder = 2;
}

const eyeShadow = creaseMaterial([0.48, 0.395, 0.16], 0.55);
const eyes = group('eyes', head, 101, 39, 24);
for (const eye of [
  { side: 'left', x: 88.2, y: 37.5, rx: 7.5, ry: 5.8,
    line: [[81.3, 37.8], [84.0, 40.2], [87.7, 41.15], [91.3, 40.5], [94.6, 38.8]] },
  { side: 'right', x: 114.8, y: 37.8, rx: 6.7, ry: 5.6,
    line: [[108.7, 38.8], [111.5, 40.6], [114.7, 41.4], [117.7, 40.6], [120.5, 38.4]] }
]) {
  const socket = group(`eye-${eye.side}`, eyes, eye.x, eye.y, headFront(eye.x, eye.y));
  const rise = (x, y) => swelling(x, y, eye.x, eye.y, eye.rx, eye.ry, 1.35);
  facePatch(socket, 'closed-lid-volume', eye.x, eye.y, eye.rx, eye.ry, rise);
  crease('closed-lid-crease', socket, eye.line, 1.08, eyeShadow, rise);
}

const nose = group('nose', head, 101.5, 44.0, headFront(101.5, 44));
facePatch(nose, 'nose-volume', 101.5, 44.0, 5.7, 4.1,
  (x, y) => swelling(x, y, 101.5, 44.0, 5.7, 4.1, 1.85));

const mouth = group('mouth', head, 102.4, 50.3, headFront(102.4, 50.3));
crease('lower-lip-light', mouth,
  [[93.2, 50.2], [98.3, 51.8], [103.6, 52.2], [109.1, 51.5], [113.0, 49.9]],
  0.93, creaseMaterial([0.921, 0.736, 0.322], 0.64));
crease('small-smile', mouth,
  [[90.9, 48.3], [95.5, 49.7], [101.4, 50.4], [107.7, 50.3], [112.3, 49.4], [114.6, 48.3]],
  1.03, creaseMaterial([0.345, 0.301, 0.124], 0.82));

const characters = [character];
function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}
render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref }, characters, render, ready: true };
</script>
